headline: Quarterly growth was mixed, with a few firms posting strong top‑line expansion while profit momentum lagged for others.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest double‑digit gains at Infosys and TCS to a standout 53.6% YoY jump at Coforge. Profit growth was uneven; HCLTech posted a 21% increase, whereas Infosys and Wipro saw profit growth of only about 6% and a 2% decline respectively. AI‑related revenue was highlighted by several firms, but concrete figures were limited. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys, introduced by HCLTech and Wipro, and raised by Coforge and Mphasis.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Multiple companies cited AI‑driven deals and revenue contributions, with HCLTech reporting $219 m AI revenue and TCS crossing the 10% AI revenue threshold.

themes.title: Diverging profit trends
themes.detail: Profit grew strongly at HCLTech and Coforge, but fell at Infosys and Wipro, reflecting differing cost pressures and pricing dynamics.
